title: Case Illustrations — The Payment an Arrangement Is Built On, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Case Illustrations — The Payment an Arrangement Is Built On, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

The payment an arrangement on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan is built on is read in one of three ways.

1. Where the scheduled monthly payment the plan record carries stands below the term's payment floor, the payment the arrangement is built on is the term's payment floor.
2. Where that payment stands at or above the floor and a payment on the plan has been sent back unpaid in the whole month ending on the handling date, the payment the arrangement is built on is the scheduled monthly payment the plan record carries together with the money sent back unpaid in that month spread evenly over the months the arrangement runs for, that spread figure rounded to the cent.
3. In every other case, the payment the arrangement is built on is the scheduled monthly payment the plan record carries.

A payment exactly equal to the floor stands at the floor and so falls to the second or third reading, not the first.

## The payment floor by term

| Term | 6-Month Deferred Interest | 12-Month Deferred Interest | 18-Month Deferred Interest | 24-Month Equal Payment | 36-Month Equal Payment | 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Payment floor | 25.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 35.00 USD | 45.00 USD | 65.00 USD | 75.00 USD |

## Cases (hypothetical)

A plan on the 24-Month Equal Payment Plan, whose payment floor is 45.00 USD, with an arrangement running 6 months:

| What the records show | The payment the arrangement is built on |
|---|---|
| Scheduled monthly payment of 38.00 USD | The floor, 45.00 USD |
| Scheduled monthly payment of 190.00 USD, with 600.00 USD sent back unpaid in the month just ending | 190.00 USD together with 600.00 USD spread over 6 months, that is 190.00 USD and 100.00 USD, giving 290.00 USD |
| Scheduled monthly payment of 190.00 USD, nothing sent back in that month | 190.00 USD |
